description: Add Anime page and menu navigation on web and mobile. Add Ongoing Series and Trending Anime content rails to the Home page on both platforms.
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/Anime.jsx: A new page following the same pattern as Movies.jsx and TV.jsx. Has tabs: Trending, Ongoing, Top Rated. Uses useInfiniteQuery with api.getAnimeTrending, api.getAnimeOngoing, api.getAnimeTopRated respectively. Renders TabNavigation + ContentGrid with type='tv' (since anime items are TV shows). Set document title to 'Anime - HIJISTREAM'.
In apps/web/src/App.jsx: Import the new Anime page via lazy(() => import('./app/Anime')). Add route <Route path='/anime' element={<Anime />} /> between /tv/:id and /player routes.
In apps/web/src/components/Layout.jsx: Add an 'Anime' NavLink (to='/anime') in the desktop nav between 'TV Shows' and before the search button. Also add the same link in the mobile menu dropdown.

In apps/web/src/app/Home.jsx: Add two new content rails after the existing ones: (1) 'Ongoing Series' using useQuery with key ['tv-on-the-air-home'] calling api.getTVOnTheAir(1), render in ContentRail with href='/tv'. (2) 'Trending Anime' using useQuery with key ['anime-trending-home'] calling api.getAnimeTrending(1), render in ContentRail with href='/anime'.

Create apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/anime.jsx: A new tab screen following the same pattern as movies.jsx. Has tabs/sections for Trending Anime, Ongoing Anime, Top Rated Anime. Uses useQuery (not infinite) for simplicity like home.jsx, calling api.getAnimeTrending, api.getAnimeOngoing, api.getAnimeTopRated. Renders FlatList with ContentRail sections for each category.

In apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx: Add a new Tabs.Screen for 'anime' between 'tv' and 'search'. Use a suitable icon - import Clapperboard or Sparkles from lucide-react-native (or use Film). Title: 'Anime'.

In apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/home.jsx: Add two new sections to the FlatList: (1) 'Ongoing Series' using useQuery with key ['tv-on-the-air-home'] calling api.getTVOnTheAir(1). (2) 'Trending Anime' using useQuery with key ['anime-trending-home'] calling api.getAnimeTrending(1). Render each as ContentRail components.
acceptance_criteria: Web has /anime route accessible from navigation with Anime link visible in both desktop and mobile nav
Anime page shows tabbed grid of anime content (Trending, Ongoing, Top Rated) with infinite scroll
Home page on web shows 'Ongoing Series' and 'Trending Anime' content rails
Mobile has an Anime tab in bottom navigation that shows anime content
Mobile home screen shows 'Ongoing Series' and 'Trending Anime' rails
verification: Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run lint to confirm no lint errors
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run build to confirm web builds successfully
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun run lint to confirm no mobile lint errors
findings: All changes implemented successfully. Web: Anime.jsx page with 3 tabs (Trending, Ongoing, Top Rated) using useInfiniteQuery, route added in App.jsx, NavLink added in Layout.jsx desktop and mobile nav. Home.jsx now has Ongoing Series and Trending Anime content rails. Mobile: anime.jsx tab screen with 3 ContentRail sections, Sparkles icon in tab bar, home.jsx has 2 new sections. All lint and build pass cleanly.
